Conv2D + MaxPool halves the size, filters double
Conv2DTranspose with stride 2 doubles the size

no activations, so it learns a PCA-like
The network in band 2 with a 32-number
code: 96x fewer numbers than the image.
Gaussian noise on the input every epoch,
convolutional and denoising runs save weights plus model_config.json, which these modes read back
Encode every training image once, fit k-NN
on the codes, return the closest images
and their distances for each query.
Encode two images, blend the codes
z = (1 - α) z1 + α z2 for α from 0 to 1,
decode each step into a picture.
